The '''Carrick family''' was a lineage of [[Human/Legends|Humans]] from [[Phaeda/Legends|Phaeda]]. [[Arvan Carrick]] and [[Reiva Carrick]] had four daughters and a son, who was named [[Zayne Carrick]].
